footer.tagline: The only productivity app built specifically for students and professionals. Private, offline-first, and completely free.

home.hero_subtitle: Timetables, transit routes, workout tracking, tasks — offline, free, and no account needed. Built for students in Germany.
home.problem_desc: You have one app for the gym, another for DB timetables, a third for grades, and a fourth for to-dos. It's fragmented, expensive, and leaks your data.
home.problem_solution: Hora replaces the chaos with a single, cohesive system.
home.pillars_subtitle: Everything you need to manage your day, integrated into one seamless timeline.
home.pillar_school_desc: Master your academic life with intelligent tools designed for German education.
home.pillar_school_b1: Automatic grade calculation with weighted averages
home.pillar_school_b2: A/B week timetables with Vertretungsplan alerts
home.pillar_transit_desc: Navigate the German transit network with confidence, even underground.
home.pillar_transit_b1: Offline route access for subway dead zones
home.pillar_transit_b2: Live delay notifications from VBB and DB
home.pillar_training_desc: Your personal fitness tracker without subscription fees or data harvesting.
home.pillar_training_b1: Log sets, reps, and weights effortlessly
home.pillar_training_b2: Progress charts that respect your privacy
home.pillar_training_b3: Auto-detected rest days and holiday modes
home.pillar_life_desc: Organize your personal life with the same precision as your studies.
home.pillar_life_b1: Habits and recurring tasks with streaks
home.pillar_life_b3: Simple finance tracking in one place
home.privacy_title: Your Data Stays on Your Device
home.privacy_desc: We don't want your data. Hora operates on a strict Local-First philosophy. There are no servers, no accounts to hack, and no tracking scripts. What you put in Hora stays in your pocket.
home.faq_a1: Yes. Hora is completely free to download and use. There are no hidden subscriptions or premium tiers.
home.faq_a2: Yes. Hora is offline-first. You can access your schedule, grades, workouts, and tasks anywhere, even without a signal.
home.faq_a3: Yes. All your data is stored locally on your device and encrypted at rest using industry-standard encryption. There is no cloud sync, no analytics, and no telemetry. Nothing ever leaves your device without your explicit action.
home.faq_q4: Can the developer access my data?
home.faq_a4: No. The developer has zero access to your information — not even crash reports leave your device. This also means that if you run into a bug, your feedback is incredibly valuable since there is no automated error reporting. Reporting issues directly helps keep development moving forward quickly.
home.cta_desc: Become one of the first users and get the most influence on how Hora evolves. Your feedback shapes the future of the app. Free forever.

features.hero_desc: Hora isn't just a todo list. It's a modular system designed to handle the complexity of modern student and professional life.
features.academic_desc: Input your grades and let Hora calculate your average automatically. Supports weighted grading and German point systems (0-15 MSS). Keep your timetable accessible instantly.
features.transit_desc: Save your frequent routes for offline access. See delays in real-time when connected, but never lose your schedule when you go underground.
features.training_desc: Ditch the notebook. Log sets, reps, and weights. Visualize your progress over time with built-in charts that respect your privacy.
features.life_desc: Track daily habits and manage complex projects with subtasks. Everything is stored in a unified database on your phone.
features.usecase_student_desc: Manage lecture clashes, track credits for your semester, and catch the right U-Bahn to campus—all before your first coffee.
features.usecase_pro_desc: Organize work projects, track gym progress during lunch, and manage personal finance without switching contexts.

privacy.hero_desc: We built Hora on a simple premise: Productivity tools shouldn't spy on you. That's why we chose a Local-First architecture.
privacy.offline_desc: When your data stays on your device, everything changes. No servers to wait for, no connections to drop, no breaches to fear.
privacy.speed_desc: No loading spinners. No server lag. Hora opens instantly because everything is already on your phone. Every tap responds immediately.
privacy.subway_desc: German mobile networks can be spotty. Hora works perfectly in dead zones, basements, and tunnels. No signal? No problem.
privacy.breach_desc: We can't lose your data because we never have it. There is no central server for hackers to target. Your information stays yours.
privacy.cta_title: Take Control of Your Digital Life

download.hero_desc: No subscriptions. No hidden fees. Just download and start.
download.desc_android: Native app as APK file. Maximum performance.
download.desc_ios: Progressive Web App. Share in Safari & add to Home Screen.
download.macos_zip_hint: Extract → Drag Nexus.app to Applications → Right-click → Open
download.desc_windows: Desktop App for Windows. Install and go.
download.windows_hint: Double-click Setup → Nexus appears in Start Menu
download.faq_a1: The app automatically notifies you when an update is available. You can then download it directly.
download.faq_q2: Can I transfer data between devices?
download.faq_a2: Yes. You can export a backup file from settings and import it onto a new device manually.
download.faq_q3: Why not on the App Store / Play Store?
download.faq_a3: We distribute directly to avoid store fees and deliver updates faster.
download.faq_q4: How do I install on macOS?
download.faq_a4: Copy the command from the download page and paste it into Terminal. The script downloads Hora, removes the macOS quarantine, and auto-installs the app to /Applications.

about.hero_desc: We believe you shouldn't have to trade your privacy for productivity.
about.story_desc: We were tired of needing five different subscriptions just to get through a semester. We were tired of apps that didn't work in the subway. So we built Hora: the tool we wished we had.
about.value1_desc: Your data belongs to you, not us.
about.value2_desc: Tools should work wherever you are.
about.value3_desc: Features you need, nothing you don't.
about.contact_desc: Hora is open to feedback. Tell us what features you need next.

privacy_policy.s2_p1: Hora was built on a "Local-First" principle. This means: All data you enter in the App is stored exclusively on your device. No data is transmitted to servers of the Provider or third parties.
privacy_policy.s2_p2: We do not collect, store, or process any personal data through the App — unless you use features that require an internet connection (e.g., real-time public transit data).
privacy_policy.s3_sub1_p1: All data you enter (timetables, grades, tasks, training data, notes, etc.) is stored exclusively on your device in an encrypted local database. The Provider has no access to this data at any time.
privacy_policy.s3_sub2_p1: When you use the real-time transit feature, requests are sent to the public APIs of VBB (Verkehrsverbund Berlin-Brandenburg) and Deutsche Bahn. Only the stop names or route information you enter are transmitted — no personal data, device IDs, or location data.
privacy_policy.s3_sub3_p1: Hora contains no analytics, no tracking, no crash reporters, and no telemetry. No usage statistics are collected whatsoever.
